summary: community.general deprecated keycloak redirects for realm_rolemapping, realm_users_info, role, user, user_execute_actions_email and user_federation; keycloak_realm_users_info moved to middleware_automation.keycloak and becomes a redirect in 14.0.0, removed in 16.0.0.
questions: What happens to keycloak_realm_users_info in community.general?
Should I switch keycloak_user tasks to middleware_automation.keycloak?
When will keycloak_role stop being redirected?

answer_card.title: community.general keycloak redirects deprecated (users)
answer_card.answer_md:
These community.general **redirects** to `middleware_automation.keycloak` are deprecated and will be removed in **community.general 16.0.0**. Switch your tasks to the FQCN `middleware_automation.keycloak.<module>` now (install it with `ansible-galaxy collection install middleware_automation.keycloak`).

- `keycloak_realm_rolemapping`, `keycloak_role`, `keycloak_user`, `keycloak_user_execute_actions_email`, `keycloak_user_federation`
- `keycloak_realm_users_info`: moved to `middleware_automation.keycloak`, replaced by a deprecated redirect in community.general 14.0.0, redirect removed in 16.0.0.
